# Accessibility Instructions (Draft)

Verify the installed, organization-approved Copilot client supports this instruction-file format before relying on automatic application.

- Define report purpose and reading order; provide meaningful titles, alt text, accessible contrast, and non-color-only encodings.
- Consider keyboard navigation, focus order, responsive/mobile layout, slicer discoverability, and screen-reader labels.
- Validate empty/error states and avoid dense layouts or misleading visual scales. Record checks and known gaps; do not claim conformance without evidence.
